author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಸ್ಥಿರದ ಬಾಳ್ವೆಯಲಿ ಏಕತಾನತೆಯಿರಲು
ದುಸ್ತರವ ಬರಗೊಡದು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ವಹಿಸೆ
ಸುಸ್ಥಿತಿಯ ತಲುಪುವೆಯೊ ವಿವಿಧತೆಯ ಒಳಗೊಯ್ಯೆ
ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವವುಳಿಯುವುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When there is monotony in an unsteady life,
take care, and it will not become unbearable;
take in variety and you will reach a good state;
your existence will endure, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Monotony can wear a life down. Stay alert to it, welcome variety, and life stays healthy and lasting.
